About Ahmed

Turning “I don’t get chemistry” into “I’ve got this.”

For many students, chemistry feels like a wall — reactions to memorise, equations that never quite add up, and an exam that decides so much about the future.

I understand that pressure, and I know how heavy it can feel for both students and their parents. I’m Ahmed Yassin, a clinical pharmacist by training and an IGCSE Chemistry teacher by passion. My scientific background means I don’t just teach the syllabus — I show students why chemistry works, connecting every topic to the real world so it finally clicks and actually stays.

In just over two years of teaching, I’ve helped more than 15 students reach the exact grades they were aiming for — including a 90% A* rate in the May/June 2026 session and a top-in-the-world achiever who scored a perfect 120/120 in May/June 2025.

If you want your child to stop fearing chemistry and start scoring in it, you’re in the right place.
